title: チャンピオンズCの後に・Fuu！活☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon wins the Champions Cup. The fans cheer loudly as she goes all out at the winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking out at each of her fans as they gaze back in adoration, Smart Falcon sees her own radiance once again. Her spirits have made a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To give Smart Falcon a little extra push as she's getting back in stride, I make a small suggestion after the winning concert…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to throw a holiday meet and greet for her fans before the Tokyo Daishoten, her final challenge.
